_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Moom ngi jottu {player_id} ci Tic Tac Toe.
Dal di ngi defar ay gëm saa woro (ngànnaaw, wàcc, walla digg) ci tablo.
Ci nguur gi, ngi gëna sax ci limu séllule (0-8) mi ngi bëgg na ngi simbol ci.
Ak example, '[4]' joxe na simbolu ngi ci séllule wàcc ci tablo.
Ak jottu {player_id}, ngi {symbol}, waaye moom ngi dëkk bu nekk {opponent_symbol}.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jëf bi ñu yónnee du topp yoon wi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} du cell bu wóor. War na nekk diggante 0 ak 8.

game_action.placed: Jottu {player_id} joxe na simbolu ({symbol}) ci séllule {cell}.

outcome.win: Jëfandikukat bi {player_id} moo ci jël ndam!
